usage: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
description:
This medal commemorates Napoleon's victory over the Austrians in the Battle of Wagram. The inscription on the obverse reads "Napoleon the Great, Emperor of the French, King of Italy, Pious, Happy, August, Invincible". The reverse reads "The enemies everywhere dispersed, destroyed, captured" and the date of 1809.
